# Generated by Pycp AOT (emit-cpp) v1.0.0
# Source entry : /home/cheryhole/Pycp/tests/modules/import_tests/typeof_class.pycp
# Runtime link : shared (libPycpRuntime)
# Module kinds : 0 static, 0 shared (one CMake target each)
# Builtin ext   : 0 static (linked in), 4 shared (loaded from stdlib/)
# Do not edit by hand; re-run: pycp --emit-cpp <entry>.pycp

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(typeof_class LANGUAGES CXX)

# Pycp 运行时 SDK 根目录（生成时写入的绝对路径；换机器用 -DPYCP_DIST=<path> 覆盖）
set(PYCP_DIST "/home/cheryhole/Pycp/build/dist" CACHE PATH "Pycp runtime SDK root")

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

# SDK 缺失时给出可操作的错误，而非晦涩的 "cannot find -lPycpRuntime"
if(NOT EXISTS "${PYCP_DIST}/include/PycpABI.hpp")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "Pycp SDK not found at: ${PYCP_DIST}\n"
        "请指定正确的 SDK 路径：cmake -S . -B build -DPYCP_DIST=<pycp 的 build/dist>")
endif()

# 入口模块与辅助源（注册/拉入桩）编进主程序可执行文件
set(PYCP_ENTRY_SRC "__pycp_main.gen.cpp")
set(PYCP_AUX_SRCS)

# ---- 主程序（入口模块 + 辅助源）----
add_executable(typeof_class ${PYCP_ENTRY_SRC} ${PYCP_AUX_SRCS})

target_include_directories(typeof_class PRIVATE "${PYCP_DIST}/include")
target_link_directories(typeof_class PRIVATE "${PYCP_DIST}/lib")

# ---- 链接 ----
target_link_libraries(typeof_class PRIVATE
    PycpRuntime
)

# rpath：让 exe 在任何目录都能找到同级 lib/ 下的运行时库
set_target_properties(typeof_class PROPERTIES
    BUILD_RPATH   "${PYCP_DIST}/lib;$ORIGIN/lib;$ORIGIN"
    INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/lib;$ORIGIN"
)

# Linux/macOS：导出主程序符号，使 import 的「进程内符号」查找
# （dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "PycpModule_xxx")）能命中链接进本程序的模块。
if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    target_link_options(typeof_class PRIVATE -rdynamic)
endif()

# 运行期部署：import io 等按「exe 同级 stdlib/」查找原生扩展，
# 且 io.so 自身 rpath 指向 $ORIGIN/../lib，故 lib/ 必须一并复制。
add_custom_command(TARGET typeof_class POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
            "${PYCP_DIST}/stdlib" $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:typeof_class>/stdlib
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
            "${PYCP_DIST}/lib" $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:typeof_class>/lib
)

# Windows：加载 DLL 只搜 exe 同级目录、不搜 lib/，故运行时 DLL 额外放一份。
# DLL 名随构建 SDK 的编译器而异：MinGW -> libPycpRuntime.dll，MSVC -> PycpRuntime.dll。
if(WIN32)
    set(_pycp_runtime_dll "")
    foreach(_pycp_dll_cand "libPycpRuntime.dll" "PycpRuntime.dll")
        if(EXISTS "${PYCP_DIST}/${_pycp_dll_cand}")
            set(_pycp_runtime_dll "${PYCP_DIST}/${_pycp_dll_cand}")
            break()
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(NOT _pycp_runtime_dll)
        foreach(_pycp_dll_cand "libPycpRuntime.dll" "PycpRuntime.dll")
            if(EXISTS "${PYCP_DIST}/lib/${_pycp_dll_cand}")
                set(_pycp_runtime_dll "${PYCP_DIST}/lib/${_pycp_dll_cand}")
                break()
            endif()
        endforeach()
    endif()
    if(_pycp_runtime_dll)
        add_custom_command(TARGET typeof_class POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
                    "${_pycp_runtime_dll}" $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:typeof_class>/
        )
    else()
        message(STATUS "Pycp: ${PYCP_DIST} 下未找到运行时 DLL（纯静态 SDK？），跳过复制到 exe 同级目录。")
    endif()
endif()
